expression_comparison.chosen_because: CA-US 5Y is already at the 0.2nd 1y percentile, so adding rates RV is not a clean incremental carry expression. USDCAD harvests the same differential with less crowded rates positioning.

considered_rates.assessment: US 10Y 4.94 is near the 1y 97.8th percentile with a 45.000000000000014bp 3m change; AU 2Y 4.835 sits at the 99.8th 1y percentile while Australian housing is tightening.
US 2s10s is 27.000000000000046bp at the 1.4th 1y percentile, so curve is an executable alternative to spot or outright duration.
CA-US 5Y is -122.00000000000001bp at the 0.2th 1y percentile — a historically extreme cross-market RV object.

considered_spot.assessment: Spot carry is the residual after the extreme CA-US rates RV is considered and rejected as too spent.

remit: positive carry and patient expressions unless a catalyst overwhelms it
stance_summary: Patient US-versus-CAD carry is cleaner in USDCAD than in already 0.2nd-percentile CA-US 5Y RV.

evidence_refs: rollup:BoC minutes flag higher energy pass-through risk
rollup:Canada August inflation holds at 3%, core stays near 2%
trade.invalidation: BoC tightening or a collapse in the US-Canada official yield gap.
trade.mispricing: Fading USD/CAD to express the same differential requires fighting both carry and the just-delivered Fed hike.
principal_risks: USD squeeze after a fully priced FOMC
trade.thesis: The US-Canada front-end gap pays carry; after CA-US 5Y RV is already historically extreme, the holding-period expression is spot.
why_now: Fed funds are higher; BoC is on hold at 2.25% with core near 2%.
